:::{#exr-affine-linear-iff-practice}
#### Choosing a constant that makes an affine map linear

By @thm-affine-linear-iff,
an [affine map](#def-affine-map) is a [linear map](#def-linear-map)
exactly when its [offset](#def-affine-offset) is $\vzero$.
For $c \in \reals$,
let $f: \reals^2 \to \reals^2$ be

$$
f(\vx) = (x_1 - x_2 + c - 2,\ 3 x_1 + c^2 - 4).
$$

For which values of $c$ is $f$ linear?

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Find the [offset of $f$](#def-affine-offset) as a function of $c$.

:::
